claim: The real native route campaign generates bounded sequence blueprints from ephemeral tactic-family instances, reserves proposal-batch coverage for a composition, compiles it to an exact controller tape, executes it through the native worker, and can retain it as the next learned boundary.

implementation.composition_kind: bounded static sequence over content-addressed ephemeral family instances
safety: composition duration is checked before admission and again against its compiled exact tape
missing observations, absent gameplay context, completed terminals, unavailable blueprint start paths, and detached descriptors fail closed in the native executor
implementation.legacy_compatibility: The frozen-policy runner retains its sealed categorical catalog. Exploratory route learning constructs only ephemeral parameterized catalogs and generated blueprints.

scope: This is bounded-composition and executor-safety evidence, not route-performance evidence. The generated sequence is deliberately small; discovery and promotion of useful replay-derived macros remain P4 work.
